subject.title: [Architecture] Formalize plugin capability manifest validation schema

question: Should OpenClaw make plugin capability manifest validation stricter now, and if so, which existing manifest shapes must remain accepted?
rationale: The report requests a potentially compatibility-affecting plugin contract change without a concrete failing input or proof of the intended supported manifest surface.

options.title: Define a compatibility-preserving validation contract
options.body: Specify canonical capability schemas, accepted legacy shapes if any, and actionable registration diagnostics before implementation.

options.title: Defer strict validation
options.body: Keep current behavior until invalid manifests demonstrate a recurring user-facing failure and a stable contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Define a compatibility-preserving validation contract
recommendation.body: Specify canonical capability schemas, accepted legacy shapes if any, and actionable registration diagnostics before implementation.
